basics.name: Alonso Caballero
basics.label: Senior Front-End Developer · E-commerce, UX/UI & Web Performance
basics.summary: Senior Front-End Developer with 10+ years building e-commerce platforms, digital products, and marketing websites. I connect business goals, UX/UI design, and engineering to create fast, accessible, measurable experiences. My work spans React and headless architectures alongside Webflow, WordPress, and Shopify, with a focus on shipping well and improving performance, technical SEO, and conversion through analytics and experimentation.

work.name: Viajes el Corte Inglés México
work.summary: I build features and reusable components for a high-traffic travel platform. Working with React, JavaScript, and Styled Components, I bring WCAG accessibility, performance, and maintainability into the implementation. I collaborate daily with UX and engineering teams across Spain, Germany, Colombia, and Chile to turn Figma designs into production-ready experiences.
highlights: Built reusable components and new features with React and Styled Components.
Contributed to code reviews and cross-functional work with international UX and engineering teams.
Continuously improved the user experience with a focus on accessibility, performance, and testing.

work.name: GAIA Design
work.summary: I supported the e-commerce evolution from Magento 1 and Magento 2 to a headless architecture using React, Next.js, Tailwind, Vercel, and DatoCMS. I developed and optimized landing pages and critical funnel touchpoints—home, PLP, PDP, cart, and checkout—bringing together UX, performance, and conversion goals.
highlights: Contributed to the move from Magento to a headless architecture with React, Next.js, Vercel, and Tailwind CSS.
Optimized key funnel pages with a focus on web performance, Core Web Vitals, and reducing friction.
Implemented VWO A/B tests to support data-informed CRO decisions.

work.name: Sales Ready Marketing / Inbox Marketing
work.summary: I designed and developed Webflow websites and landing pages, from interpreting Figma and Adobe XD designs through launch. My work included CMS setups, interactions, forms, Zapier automations, and measurement with GA4 and Meta Pixel, with attention to responsive UX, performance, and conversion.
highlights: Delivered Webflow websites and landing pages end to end from Figma and Adobe XD.
Integrated analytics, Meta Pixel, and Zapier automations.
Implemented responsive experiences, interactions, and conversion-focused optimizations.

work.name: Interjet
work.summary: As part of the UX team, I built responsive interfaces, landing pages, and microsites for the airline’s digital platform. I contributed to Oracle Responsys email marketing campaigns and ongoing improvements to global components and high-traffic sections, including a Disneyland ticketing microsite and pages for the Canadian market.
highlights: Developed the Disneyland ticket sales microsite and landing pages for the Canadian market.
E-mail marketing campaigns with Oracle Responsys focused on conversion across different markets.
Continuous improvements to key site components increasing visual consistency and usability.

work.name: Liverpool
work.summary: As part of the Front-End team at liverpool.com.mx, I created microsites, landing pages, and conversion-focused e-commerce experiences. I contributed to the Oracle ATG Web Commerce (BCC) migration, developed HTML prototypes for a new checkout, and partnered with international teams on launches for Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, and West Elm.
highlights: Migration to Oracle ATG Web Commerce and development of HTML prototypes for the new checkout.
Launch of international multisites: Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn and West Elm.
Development of landing pages for commercial campaigns and optimization of key site components.

work.name: CTIN (Telmex Technology & Innovation Center)
work.summary: I developed interactive websites with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery. I also delivered technical workshops at Aldea Digital TELMEX, teaching web-development fundamentals and digital skills.
highlights: Development of interactive websites with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and jQuery.
Delivered technical training workshops at Aldea Digital TELMEX.

work.name: Freelance
work.position: Front-End & CMS Developer · Webflow, WordPress & Shopify
work.summary: I develop and optimize corporate websites, landing pages, and stores in Webflow, WordPress, and Shopify. I take projects from implementation through launch, combining HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with React, Vue, or Astro when appropriate. I apply web performance, technical SEO, accessibility, and UX practices to deliver experiences ready to scale.
highlights: Delivered websites and e-commerce experiences end to end in Webflow, WordPress, and Shopify across industries.
Customized themes, templates, CSS, JavaScript, and Liquid around project needs.
Applied web performance, technical SEO, and UX practices to improve visibility, speed, and experience.
